# Automatic PR Review Requirements Checklist: Automatically Review Symphony Pull Requests

**Purpose**: Apply formal implementation-gate scrutiny to the completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and traceability of automatic PR review requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the peer/human PR reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are eligibility requirements complete for label inheritance, durable managed-PR identity, same-repository heads, and excluded human/fork PRs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all required review surfaces explicitly enumerated, including diff, conversation, formal reviews, inline comments, current-head checks, and merge state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements documented for every finding disposition: corrected, non-actionable, deferred for authorization, and blocked? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK004 Are targeted validation and full-gate obligations defined for successful, blocked, and impossible-to-run validation paths? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Are product-contract and operator-documentation obligations complete for labeling, eligibility, recovery, ownership, and handoff? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is “created by Symphony” unambiguously tied to the durable originating-issue relationship rather than author identity or text? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK007 Is “next successful scheduling opportunity” sufficiently bounded by configured polling behavior and distinguished from an immediate webhook guarantee? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is “complete pull request diff” scoped to the checkpoint head so stale revisions and stale checks cannot satisfy review requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK009 Are “actionable,” “authorized scope,” and “unrelated changes” defined sufficiently for consistent repair decisions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the exact human-handoff condition clear when checks are pending, skipped, cancelled, flaky, external, or unavailable? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-014, §FR-015]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are label-first handoff requirements consistent across the specification, state model, and managed-PR contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Architecture and Lifecycle]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the single originating-issue owner consistent with automatic dispatch, retry, revision, and terminal-state requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-012, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the `review_pending`, running, blocked, and `awaiting_review` meanings mutually exclusive and consistent across design artifacts? [Consistency, Plan §Architecture and Lifecycle, Data Model §State Transitions]
- [ ] CHK014 Do automatic repair requirements consistently preserve the same branch and pull request without creating a second scheduler identity? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK015 Are automatic-review completion requirements consistent with mandatory human approval and the prohibition on autonomous merge? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §SC-006]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can label-before-handoff and automatic-dispatch outcomes be objectively observed without relying on internal implementation details? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK017 Can zero duplicate concurrent review runs be measured across repeated polls, retries, and restart recovery? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the 100% review-surface accounting criterion define a traceable handled, non-actionable, or blocked disposition for each item? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK019 Can every corrected finding be traced to targeted validation and every review-ready handoff to full-gate evidence? [Traceability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK020 Does lifecycle validation enumerate observable expected outcomes for every scenario named in SC-007? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are partial-failure recovery requirements defined when PR creation, push, label application, or checkpoint writing succeeds alone? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are restart and replay requirements defined both before and after automatic dispatch consumption? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for multiple PRs referencing one issue or branch without creating competing writers? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK024 Are stop/reconciliation outcomes specified for label removal, issue closure, PR closure, and merge while queued or running? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK025 Are later requested changes, new failing checks, and already-handled events clearly distinguished for revision dispatch? [Coverage, Spec §US3/AC3, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK026 Are permission, flaky, external-service, security-sensitive, and scope-expansion failures assigned explicit blocker or authorization outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §US2/AC4, §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements and Governance

- [ ] CHK027 Are credential-safety requirements explicit that all GitHub mutations remain host-mediated and no credentials enter the workspace? [Security, Constitution §II, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK028 Are observability requirements specific about stable transition/failure context, operator summaries, and recovery actions? [Completeness, Constitution §VI, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK029 Are polling/API-efficiency constraints stated clearly enough to prevent extra review-surface calls for unrelated issues? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK030 Are repository contract, red-green-refactor, targeted-test, and full-gate obligations traceable to implementation work? [Traceability, Constitution §I, §V]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK031 Is the assumption of one managed PR per originating issue reconciled with the multiple-PR edge case and recovery behavior? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §Managed Pull Request]
- [ ] CHK032 Are GitHub check APIs, pagination, head-SHA scoping, and required-context retrieval failure documented as dependencies with failure behavior? [Dependency, Contract §Context enrichment]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the boundary between repository-defined review policy and optional provider-specific review assistance explicit? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Are fork and cross-repository exclusions consistent across the spec, plan, data model, and acceptance scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §Managed Pull Request]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline and link to relevant evidence.
